Runtime home; state, binaries, and per-scenario data.

exclusions.reason: Linux process pseudo-filesystem; it has no durable storage bytes.
Kernel sysfs; it is virtual and must not enter disk accounting.
Device filesystem; device nodes are not durable file storage.
Runtime tmpfs; it is ephemeral and may change during a census.

exclusions.name: node_modules
exclusions.reason: Package-manager dependency tree; regenerable from the lockfile and 4.4M of the host's 13.2M inodes. Skipped subtrees stay in the statfs-measured remainder at the device root and are counted in scan_coverage.pruned_directories.
